question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **converts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Converts" **is the correct word to use in the context of changing or transforming something from one state to another. (परिवर्तित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He converts his ideas into actionable plans efficiently.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **converts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exceeds **(अधिक होना): To go beyond a set limit or standard.

 
 
• **Example:** His performance exceeds all expectations.
 
 
 
• **Crates **(बक्से): Large shipping containers, typically made of wood.
 
 
• **Example: **They packed the fragile items in wooden crates for shipping.
 
 
 
• **Bows** (झुकना): To bend the upper part of the body forward as a gesture of respect or greeting.
 
 
• **Example:** The performer bows to the audience at the end of the show.
